text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Marrow Fieldworks you can find across Moss's notes and #central-random? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.
reply_text:
I've sent Tobias the list in his DM. There are three Marrow Fieldworks ticket numbers, and one of them is an inference he needs to check.

- **#4409**, from Moss's note "Central handoffs next week" (2 Jan 2026): a report on the Gatehouse Check-In screen keeps timing out at the Salina North yard. Hollis flagged it as open before the account changed hands on 5 Jan 2026.
- **#4412**, from the same note: a minor glitch in the text-message prompt drivers get. Hollis flagged it as open at the same time.
- **#8841**, from #central-random (13 Oct, 09:27): Tobias flagged it himself because West yard Door 2 is still double-booking flatbeds that check in early. That thread says "Tobias's dealer account", not Marrow Fieldworks. I counted it because the handoff note calls Marrow Fieldworks "Pree's dealer account" before it changed hands. I asked him to confirm it's the right account.

I left out FR-882 from the same Moss note, because it's a feature request from Marrow Agrisupply, a different account. Marrow Fieldworks doesn't come up in any of Moss's other notes.

Tobias can see everything I used: he's a member of #central-random, and Moss's notes are public. There are no money terms in any of it, so no approval was needed.

The brain's search was running on keyword matching only, and some pages haven't been checked for company names yet. I checked Moss's notes and the channel directly, but a page elsewhere that refers to the account by another name could have been missed.
